work: DEFECT 2 — scroll goal verification, baseline vs remediated
defect: A scroll goal could return SUCCESS from previousActions alone, with a byte-identical verdict at scrollY=0 and scrollY=500.
method: Both implementations are bundled from source and driven with the SAME synthetic observed state. The pricing section is modelled at document y=3000 with a 900px viewport, matching the real /long fixture geometry. No browser, no agent loop.

states.label: scrollY=0 (page never moved)
states.requestedGoal: scroll down to the pricing section

states.label: scrollY=500 (partial scroll)
states.requestedGoal: scroll down to the pricing section

genuinelySatisfied.label: scrollY=2900 — the section really is in view

remediated.reason: Scroll goal verified from observed state: target 'pricing' is inside the observed viewport at 2900px.

genuinelySatisfied.conclusion: The remediated verifier still returns SUCCESS when observed state supports it. The fix did not make scroll goals unsatisfiable.
